name: LineFormat
description: Represents line and arrowhead formatting. For a line, the LineFormat object contains formatting information for the line itself; for a shape with a border, this object contains formatting information for the shape's border.
example:
Set myDocument = ActivePresentation.Slides(1)

With myDocument.Shapes.AddLine(100, 100, 200, 300).Line

    .DashStyle = msoLineDashDotDot

    .ForeColor.RGB = RGB(50, 0, 128)

    .BeginArrowheadLength = msoArrowheadShort

    .BeginArrowheadStyle = msoArrowheadOval

    .BeginArrowheadWidth = msoArrowheadNarrow

    .EndArrowheadLength = msoArrowheadLong

    .EndArrowheadStyle = msoArrowheadTriangle

    .EndArrowheadWidth = msoArrowheadWide

End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the creator of the specified object.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a Long that represents the four-character creator code for the application in which the specified object was created. For example, if the object was created in Microsoft PowerPoint, this property returns the hexadecimal number 50575054. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent object for the specified object.

properties.name: BackColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the background color for the specified fill or patterned line. Read/write.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadLength
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: BeginArrowheadWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the arrowhead at the beginning of the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: DashStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the dash style for the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: EndArrowheadLength
properties.description: Returns or sets the length of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: EndArrowheadStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the style of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: EndArrowheadWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the width of the arrowhead at the end of the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: ForeColor
properties.description: Returns or sets a ColorFormat object that represents the foreground color for the fill, line, or shadow. Read/write.

properties.name: Pattern
properties.description: Sets or returns a value that represents the pattern applied to the specified line. Read/write.

properties.name: Style
properties.description: Returns or sets the line style. Read/write.

properties.name: Transparency
properties.description: Returns or sets the degree of transparency of the specified fill, shadow, or line as a value between 0.0 (opaque) and 1.0 (clear). Read/write.

properties.name: Visible
properties.description: Returns or sets the visibility of the specified object or the formatting applied to the specified object. Read/write.

properties.name: Weight
properties.description: Returns or sets the thickness of the specified line, in points. Read/write.

properties.name: InsetPen
properties.description: Determines whether to draw lines on the inside of a specified shape. Read/write.
